# Coder-B Apps

> Official product information, support documentation, and privacy policies for apps made by Coder-B.

## Featured app

- [Gentle Bye](https://coder-b.github.io/App/GentleBye/): An iPhone and iPad kids video timer that helps parents select public YouTube videos, set a total viewing-time limit, and guide a calm transition when the session ends.
- [Gentle Bye support](https://coder-b.github.io/App/GentleBye/support.html): Setup instructions, product behavior, frequently asked questions, and troubleshooting.
- [Gentle Bye privacy policy](https://coder-b.github.io/App/GentleBye/privacy.html): Data collection, providers, retention, choices, and deletion requests.

## Important facts about Gentle Bye

- Parents select every video and arrange the queue.
- A session uses one total viewing-time limit.
- Gentle reminders begin during the final 90 seconds.
- The app does not require a name, email address, or password.
- Search uses YouTube's strict SafeSearch setting, but parents should review every video.
- Gentle Bye is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by YouTube or Google.
